items.name: spy-gap-fade
items.description: Regime-aware mean-reversion backtester for SPY. Trend-aligned gap fade with 200-day SMA filter. 5-year backtest: Sharpe 1.41, profit factor 1.32, max DD -3.5%.

items.name: SystematicTrading_DynamicExposure
items.description: ML-driven backtesting framework for SPY strategies using volatility, trend, and technical indicators. Compares baseline, TCVS, mean reversion, and dynamic exposure strategies with performance metrics and visualization.

items.name: mean-reversion-backtest
items.description: Z-score based mean-reversion trading strategy on SPY, backtested with Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, and hit rate analysis

items.name: MeanReversion-Backtester
items.description: A Python framework for backtesting mean reversion trading strategies, including a simple single-asset approach (SPY) and an advanced multi-asset Simons-style strategy with z-score normalization and inverse-volatility weighting. Generates performance metrics and visualizations for equity, returns, and drawdowns.

items.name: ml-mean-reversion-backtest
items.description: Walk-forward backtest of an ML-filtered intraday mean-reversion strategy with portfolio constraints, transaction costs, SPY benchmark, and calibration diagnostics.

items.name: mean-reversion-SPY-QQQ
items.description: Mean-reversion trading strategy using SPY-QQQ spread, with backtesting, transaction costs, and parameter tuning in Python

items.name: systematic-trading-backtester
items.description: Backtests mean-reversion and momentum strategies on historical SPY data

items.name: SPY-IBS-Mean-Reversion-Strategy
items.description: Institutional-grade Python backtest engine & daily live signal monitor for SPY IBS Mean Reversion strategy (1993–Present) with zero look-ahead bias and dynamic equity charts

items.name: Project_Output
items.description: Backtesting Momentum, Mean-Reversion, and Machine-Learning Strategies on SPY (2006–2025)

items.name: volatility-scaled-momentum-mean-reversion-strategy
items.description: Algorithmic trading project implementing a volatility-scaled momentum and mean reversion strategy on SPY (2010–2024) with backtesting, risk management, and performance analysis.

items.name: SPY-ETF-Backtest
items.description: C++ backtesting comparing trend following with mean reversion and buy and hold using SPY data, including transaction costs, dividends, drawdown analysis, performance metrics, and testing execution and accuracy.

items.name: quant-mean-reversion-trading-engine
items.description: Python-based institutional flow and mean reversion trading model that analyzes SPY reversal signals to confirm bullish and bearish breakout entries in correlated equities. Includes a custom backtesting engine and performance evaluation tools for swing trading research.

items.name: honest-backtester
items.description: A daily backtest engine built to make lying to yourself hard - enforced execution lag, explicit costs, walk-forward selection - plus an honest study: daily mean reversion on SPY does not survive costs and decay

items.name: Donchian-Pullback-Backtest
items.description: Backtesting framework for a Donchian Pullback strategy on SPY hourly data. Implements trend-filtered mean reversion entries with grid search optimisation and Monte Carlo validation. Achieves 2.0 Sharpe and 80% win rate but limited by low trade frequency.

items.name: Vectorized_Quantitative_Strategy_Comparison
items.description: Compared Mean Reversion, Trend Following (Momentum), and Buy-and-Hold strategies on SPY using a fully vectorized NumPy backtesting engine. Evaluated each strategy using annualized returns, volatility, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown while avoiding look-ahead bias through lagged signal execution.
